twofa.title: Two-step verification is off
twofa.sub: Required for the Super Admin before the public launch. Every action here goes to the audit log.
twofa.dialogDesc: A 6-digit code from an authenticator app (TOTP) every time you open the panel. It arrives before launch (Phase 5); until then, this notice shows on every page.
twofa.step1: Open the authenticator app and scan the account code
twofa.step1Sub: The QR code shows here; the secret is never displayed again.
twofa.step2Sub: Confirms the app and the panel are in sync.
twofa.step3Sub: Eight single-use codes, in case you lose your phone.
twofa.notYet: It cannot be turned on yet: nothing is saved in this phase.

forbidden.body: Your account is not one of the HelloSquad Super Admins. Nothing was opened, and your business is right where it was.
forbidden.signOut: Sign out and use another account

contas.title: Accounts
contas.desc: Who uses HelloSquad: business, plan, credit balance, members and language. Open an account to see members, statement and usage.
contas.searchPlaceholder: Search by business, address or owner email

conta.notFoundBody: This address does not match any HelloSquad account.

conta.recentAll: See everything in the audit log

catalogo.title: Catalog
catalogo.desc: The 46 deliveries of the seven agents: depth, price in credits, availability, required integrations and acceptance testing. Price and availability change by version, and every version goes to the audit log.
catalogo.locked: Locked until the price is approved
catalogo.note: Nothing is for sale: the "price commercially approved" lock is off for every delivery, and prices are provisional until the owner decides.
catalogo.metHomologatedDetail: {n, plural, =0 {none in homologation} other {# in homologation}}
catalogo.metWaitingDetail: {engine} on the engine · {integration} on an integration

homolSummary.awaiting_engine: {n, plural, one {# waits for the engine} other {# wait for the engine}}
homolSummary.awaiting_integration: {n, plural, one {# waits for an integration} other {# wait for an integration}}

catalogo.versionTitle: Version 1 is the seeded catalog; each new price saved creates a version. Homologation and sale change in place and stay in the history.

planos.title: Plans and top-ups
planos.desc: Free and subscriptions with credits per cycle and validity; one-off top-ups with their own validity. Every save becomes a new version and goes to the audit log.
planos.lockNote: Sales lock: without a commercially approved price, the plan is not shown to customers.
planos.missingFields: Bonus, rollover and members per plan do not exist in the database yet; they show up when the owner defines the plan fields.

pagamentos.title: Payments
pagamentos.desc: Subscriptions, top-ups, webhooks and reconciliation, by provider. The Asaas and Mercado Pago accounts do not exist yet.
pagamentos.secretsNote: Secrets never show in the panel: only configured or missing.

environmentState.sandbox: Sandbox, once the account is created

pagamentos.idempotencyNote: Each event is applied only once, by the event id key. If the same id arrives again, it is recorded as an ignored duplicate and neither credits nor charges again. Reprocessing uses the same id: what was already applied does not repeat.
pagamentos.reconciliationNote: Reconciliation is marked on each webhook, in the Webhooks tab ("Mark reconciled", with a reason). Failed charges are listed here.

auditoria.title: Audit log
auditoria.desc: Billing, credit statement, support access, confirmed memory, approvals, settings and prompts, whoever did it. Nothing is deleted. Filter by who, account, type and period.
auditoria.invalidPeriod: Invalid period: the end date comes after the start date, within 366 days.
auditoria.exportTitle: Exports the current filter: the events loaded on this page.
auditoria.exported: {n, plural, =0 {No events on this page with the current filters; nothing exported.} one {# event from this page exported as CSV, with the current filters.} other {# events from this page exported as CSV, with the current filters.}}

fila.title: Job queue
fila.desc: The runs in the queues: queued, running, waiting for approval and the ones that failed. Open a run to see its steps and events.

run.title: Run {id}
run.stepsEmpty: No step recorded in this run.
run.eventsEmpty: No event recorded in this run.
run.notFoundBody: This address does not match any run.

modelos.title: Models and costs
modelos.desc: How much AI costs and which model each step uses. Each call keeps the price of its time; customers never see this screen.
modelos.costsEmpty: No AI call in the period: the runtime runs in simulated mode until the API key arrives.
modelos.how: Cost of a call = input tokens × input price + cache read × cache price + output × output price, at the price in force when the call happened. In reais, at the informed exchange rate.

squad.title: Squad
squad.desc: The seven HelloSquad agents. Open an agent to see its soul, skills, tools and what it reads before each job. Every change becomes a new version.
squad.metAgentsSub: Nexo coordinates; the other six execute
squad.metRunsSub: jobs that ran with the squad
squad.metDraftsSome: waiting to be published; the runtime uses the active version
squad.tableSub: color, shape and name are official (DS); model, effort and deliveries come from the active agent.yaml version
squad.withSkill: {n, plural, one {# with skill} other {# with skill}}
squad.runs30: {n, plural, one {# run in 30 days} other {# runs in 30 days}}
squad.rule: A change to the soul, a skill or agent.yaml creates a new version, never a silent edit. A draft does not reach the runtime until it is published; every run records the versions it used. Going back to a version creates a new version with the old content; nothing is deleted.

alma.empty: This agent has no soul in the database yet. Run the squad seed.
alma.inPrompt: {n} of {total} sections go into the prompt
alma.draftCheck: Check "What it reads" with the draft before publishing.

versions.publishDesc: The next runs will use this version. Version {active} stays in the history as superseded.
versions.publishDescFirst: The next runs will use this version.
versions.publishCheck: The publication goes to the audit log under your name. Nothing is deleted.
versions.discardKeep: The draft stays in the history as discarded and in the audit log.
versions.restoreDesc: Creates a new version, already active, with the content of version {v}. The next runs will use it; nothing is deleted.
versions.reasonHint: Optional, but it helps whoever reads the history.

done.saved: Draft saved as version {v}. Publish it to reach the runtime.
done.published: Version {v} published. The next runs use this version.
done.restored: Version {v} active, with the content of version {from}.

versions.title: Versions
versions.sub: going back creates a new version with the old content; nothing is deleted
versions.restoreBlocked: A draft is waiting: publish or discard it before going back to a version.
versions.diffLegend: Side by side: removed on the left, added on the right.
versions.diffNone: No difference between the two versions.
versions.sameLines: {n, plural, one {# unchanged line} other {# unchanged lines}}

skills.none: This agent has no delivery in the catalog.
skills.emptyBody: Every catalog delivery gets a skill: procedure, delivery format and acceptance criteria. Until then, {name} does not run this delivery.
skills.fieldContentHint: Procedure, delivery format and acceptance criteria live in the "##" sections. Saving creates a draft; nothing changes in the runtime until it is published.

ferramentas.empty: This agent has no agent.yaml in the database yet. Run the squad seed.
ferramentas.draftCheck: A tool outside the list is refused by the runtime. Check before publishing.
ferramentas.editNote: Changes to the agent contract. Saving creates an agent.yaml draft; the rest of the file, with its comments, stays the same.
ferramentas.autonomySub: a ceiling; every external action still asks for authorization
ferramentas.autonomyNote: Analyzing and preparing are autonomous; executing only with a registered permission.
ferramentas.memorySub: what it reads and what it may suggest (a suggestion only becomes a rule once confirmed)
ferramentas.deliveriesSub: what this agent delivers, by catalog code
ferramentas.yamlSub: squad/{agent}/agent.yaml as the runtime reads it

le.noDrafts: No draft waiting: the assembly with drafts is the same as the active one.

origin.database: database versions (the same the runtime records)
origin.files: squad/ files (no active version in the database)

le.how: Assembled in the same order as the runtime. Price, plan and catalog never go in here: they come from the database on every conversation.

regras.title: Business rules
regras.desc: Operating rules written and marked paragraph by paragraph. What goes into the prompt becomes part of the shared rules of the seven agents; what is pending shows as such, and the panel does not apply it.
regras.none: No rules document in the database.
regras.metDocsSub: {prompt} go into the prompt · {internal} internal reference
regras.metPendingSome: waiting for the owner’s decision; the panel does not apply them

legend.decided: A recorded decision by the owner.
legend.pending: Waiting for the owner’s decision. The panel does not apply it.

regras.flagInternal: The team reads this document here; no agent reads it. Prices, plans and catalog never go into the prompt: they come from the database on every conversation.
regras.flagDoc: Decided and current-base paragraphs go to the shared rules (squad/README.md), which reach the prompt of the seven once published. Pending and proposals do not.
regras.flagFile: This is {file}: it goes into the prompt of the seven, together with each one’s soul. Prices, plans and catalog never go into the prompt: they come from the database on every conversation.
regras.pendingNotApplied: Pending: the panel does not apply it
regras.saved: Version {v} of "{title}" saved. It stays in the audit log.
regras.versionsSub: every save is a new version; the latest one is valid
regras.toPromptDesc: Saves a new version of the document marked "goes into the prompt". Decided and current-base paragraphs become a draft of the shared rules, which only reaches the runtime when you publish it.
regras.toInternalDesc: Saves a new version of the document as an internal reference. The shared rules get a draft without this document, valid only once you publish it.
regras.sharedDraft: Draft of the shared rules (version {v}) waiting to be published.
regras.sharedDraftCheck: The seven agents start reading the new text when you publish it. Check "What it reads" with the drafts.
regras.sharedLineMissing: I could not find this paragraph exactly once in the file; nothing was saved.

consumo.title: Usage by customer
consumo.desc: By account and period: requests, credits charged and AI cost in deliveries and in conversation. Conversation charges no credit, but it costs: it shows up here. Alerts only warn; nothing changes automatically.
consumo.fxNone: No exchange rate in Models and costs: values in R$ stay empty.
consumo.metRequestsSub: {n, plural, =0 {no job asked of the squad} one {jobs asked of the squad in # account} other {jobs asked of the squad in # accounts}}
consumo.metConversationSub: Conversation charges no credit, but it costs: {share} of the AI cost.
consumo.metConversationSubNone: Conversation charges no credit, but it costs.
consumo.metPerCreditSub: AI cost in R$ per credit charged
consumo.alertsSub: Reference ranges proposed by the prototype, to be defined with Vic. Nothing changes automatically: the alert only warns.
consumo.noRule: No range in force for this reading.

how.ai_cost_per_credit_brl: {brl} of AI (deliveries and conversation) ÷ {credits} credits charged.
how.gross_margin: 1 − {brl} of AI ÷ {revenue} in credits ({credits} at {ref}, example).
how.trendMany: Last {days} days against the previous {days}; average of {n} accounts, weighted by cost.
how.turn: Average cost per turn in the period: {usd}.

none.ai_cost_per_credit_brl: No credit charged in the filter.
none.gross_margin: No credit charged in the filter.
none.cost_per_turn_trend: No account in the filter has two weeks of usage to compare.

consumo.inAttention: {n, plural, =0 {Accounts needing attention} one {# account needs attention} other {# accounts need attention}}
consumo.noneEval: No account in the filter with data to assess.
consumo.marginNote: The margin uses the credit at {ref} (the prototype’s example value) and the exchange rate of {date} (US$ 1 = {brl}). Price and credits come last: both stay provisional until Vic decides.
consumo.marginNoteNoFx: The margin uses the credit at {ref} (the prototype’s example value). Price and credits come last: it stays provisional until Vic decides.
consumo.byClientSub: {period} · {n, plural, =0 {no account with usage} one {# account with usage} other {# accounts with usage}}
consumo.accounts: {n, plural, =0 {no account} one {# account} other {# accounts}}
consumo.inAttentionFoot: {n, plural, =0 {none needs attention} one {# needs attention} other {# need attention}}
consumo.empty: No account with usage in the period.
consumo.emptyAccount: This account had no usage in the period.
consumo.howText: AI cost from the price table per model (Models and costs), in US$. AI per credit = AI cost in R$, deliveries and conversation, ÷ credits charged. Estimated margin = 1 − AI cost in R$ ÷ (credits × {ref}, example credit value). Trend = change in the cost per turn in the last {days} days against the previous {days}; in the total, average weighted by cost. — = no credit charged or no two weeks of usage to compare.

qualidade.title: Delivery quality
qualidade.desc: By delivery type, by month and by prompt version: approved first time, adjustments, not approved, AI cost per approved, agent errors and failed calls. Compare two months to know whether a prompt or model change improved the result.
qualidade.topSub: {n, plural, =0 {0 deliveries} one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}} · change against {month}, {beforeN, plural, =0 {0 deliveries} one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}}
qualidade.types: {n, plural, =0 {no type} one {# type} other {# types}}
qualidade.byTypeSub: {period} · {n, plural, =0 {no type with deliveries} one {# type with deliveries} other {# types with deliveries}}
qualidade.byTypeNote: In the total, rates come from the sums of the rows: approved first time and adjustments over deliveries; cost per approved over approved deliveries.
qualidade.empty: No delivery decided in the period.
qualidade.byMonthSub: counts with the rate per delivery below
qualidade.byVersionSub: the prompt version that produced the first version of each delivery
qualidade.emptyVersions: No delivery with a recorded prompt version in the period.
qualidade.cmpSub: measures whether a prompt or model change improved things
qualidade.cmpSummary: {betterN, plural, one {# of {total} metrics improved} other {# of {total} metrics improved}}{worseN, plural, =0 {} one { and # got worse} other { and # got worse}} against {month}.
qualidade.cmpNote: Not approved, errors and failed calls are compared by rate, because the months have different volumes and the current month has not closed yet.
qualidade.note: Quality only measures: no prompt version, model or rule changes because of these numbers.
qualidade.cardNone: No decided delivery to compare with {month}.

saude.title: API health
saude.desc: By provider: whether it is working, calls and failures, spend and the last refusal for balance. Keys never show here, only whether they are configured. The balance is entered by hand, with an alert below the threshold.
saude.calls: {n, plural, =0 {0 calls} one {# call} other {# calls}}
saude.balanceTitle: Balance read on the provider’s dashboard

balance.title: Enter the {name} balance
balance.desc: What the provider’s dashboard shows now. It goes into the history and the audit log; the alert only warns.
balance.readAtHint: When the balance was read on the provider’s dashboard.
balance.reasonHint: From 10 to 500 characters; it goes into the audit log.

invalid.currency: Use the three-letter currency code, for example USD.
invalid.read_at: Enter when the balance was read; it cannot be in the future.
invalid.alert_below: Enter an amount, for example 50.00, or leave it empty.
invalid.reason: Write a reason with 10 to 500 characters.

saude.noBalance: No balance entered: enter what the provider’s dashboard shows.
saude.noThresholdHint: With no threshold, the panel does not warn.
saude.belowAction: Top up on the {name} dashboard and enter the new balance here.
saude.pace: At the pace of the last 7 days, {perDay} per day, the balance lasts about {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
saude.paceUnderDay: At the pace of the last 7 days, {perDay} per day, the balance does not last a day.
saude.nothingAuto: Nothing changes by itself: the alert only warns.
saude.failing24: {name}: {n, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} in 24 h
saude.metSpend30Sub: sum of the providers with spend, from the steps of each run
saude.how: Spend comes from the steps of each run (run_steps), at the price of the time. The balance comes from the provider’s dashboard, entered by hand: the panel warns below the alert and nothing changes by itself. Provider secrets never show in the panel: only configured or missing.

purpose.anthropic: Language models of the seven agents
purpose.email: Invitation, “Needs you”, delivery ready, payment, password

note.anthropic_simulated: Runtime in simulated mode until the API key arrives (LLM_PROVIDER).
note.image_engine_not_integrated: Vic’s engine, being integrated. No vendor is chosen here.
note.asaas_account_not_created: Account not created yet; adapter ready and tested against a fake server (S2e).
note.mercadopago_account_not_created: Account not created yet; adapter ready and tested against a fake server (S2e).
note.email_local_only: Local only: Mailpit (S2f). Production provider not chosen.

acoes.reasonHint: Stays in the audit log with your name.
acoes.invalid: The API rejected the request. Check the marked fields.

enter.title: Enter {name}’s workspace
enter.desc: Opens a read-only support session with a time limit. Account, reason and duration go to the audit log, and the account holder gets an email about it.
enter.reasonHint: Example: check the publishing error the account owner asked about.
enter.durationHint: The session closes by itself at the end.
enter.done: Support session in {name} open until {until}, read only. Recorded in the audit log.
enter.busy: You already have a session open in this account.
enter.suspended: Suspended account: reactivate it before entering.

session.label: Support
session.readOnly: Read only: the product screens don’t open for support yet; the product API already answers reads.
session.endDesc: Support reading stops now. The end goes to the audit log and to the account’s access history.
session.ended: Support session in {name} ended. Recorded in the audit log.

credit.title: Adjust {name}’s credits
credit.desc: Use it to return credits after a failure or fix an entry. The adjustment goes to the statement with the reason.
credit.amountHint: Negative to remove; up to 2 decimals. Available now: {available}.
credit.amountInvalid: Enter a non-zero amount with up to 2 decimals (e.g. 10 or -5.50).
credit.done: Adjustment of {amount} posted: balance {before} → {after}. Recorded in the audit log.
credit.duplicate: This adjustment had already been posted (same key); nothing changed. Balance {balance}.

status.reasonHint: Stays in the audit log and in the account history.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}
suspend.desc: Subscription renewal and scheduled routines stop; the subscription is not cancelled and nothing is deleted. Members see the suspended-account notice. You can reactivate later.
suspend.done: {name} suspended. Data is kept. Recorded in the audit log.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}
reactivate.desc: Subscription renewal and routines run again, and the notice disappears for members.
reactivate.done: {name} reactivated. Recorded in the audit log.

catalog.title: {id} · {name}: price and sale
catalog.desc: Each change becomes a new record with the reason; the previous price version never changes. Values stay provisional until the owner decides.
catalog.creditsNone: No price yet. Becomes the first version.
catalog.creditsInvalid: Enter credits above zero, with up to 2 decimals.
catalog.approvedHint: An approved price can’t be provisional; while the delivery is for sale, only an approved price.
catalog.approvedInvalid: Uncheck "Provisional" to mark the price as approved.
catalog.homologationHint: Reopening testing for a delivery on sale is refused: take it off sale first.
catalog.forSaleHint: It only goes on sale with testing done and the current price approved and not provisional; if something is missing, the API says what.

done.price: Price for {id} saved as a new version. Recorded in the audit log.
done.homologation: Testing for {id}: {status}. Recorded in the audit log.
done.saleOn: {id} is on sale. Recorded in the audit log.
done.saleOff: {id} is off sale. Recorded in the audit log.

catalog.recentEmpty: No catalog change through the panel yet.
catalog.noteLive: Provisional prices stay marked. Only what has testing done and an approved, non-provisional price goes on sale.

offer.title: {name}: version {next}
offer.desc: Saves the new version with the reason. Version {version} stays as it is, forever, and shows in the history.
offer.done: {name} saved as version {next}. Recorded in the audit log.
offer.amountHintPlan: Empty or unchanged = keeps the current price; different = new price.
offer.lockHint: For sale stays locked until the price is commercially approved and no longer provisional.

invalid.credits: Enter credits above zero, with up to 2 decimals.
invalid.amount: Enter the price with up to 2 decimals (e.g. 49.90).
invalid.approved_commercially: Uncheck "Provisional" to mark the price as approved.

offer.historySub: From the audit log; read only, never editable. Version 1 of each offer came from the seed and doesn’t show here.
offer.historyEmpty: No version saved through the panel yet.

requeue.title: Requeue run {id}?
requeue.desc: {what}. The run goes back to the queue with attempts reset. A run that already reserved credits is refused: then the way is to request the work again.
requeue.done: Run {id} back in the queue (attempts: {attempts}). Recorded in the audit log.

cancel.title: Cancel run {id}?
cancel.desc: {what}. The run leaves the queue and doesn’t come back by itself. Whether to charge credits on cancellation is still a pending decision in Business rules.
cancel.reasonHint: Stays in the audit log and in the run error.
cancel.done: Run {id} cancelled. Recorded in the audit log.

run.recentEmpty: No run requeued or cancelled through the panel yet.

reprocess.title: Reprocess {event}?
reprocess.desc: Checks the charge with the provider and applies the status through the same billing path. Each event counts once: what was already applied doesn’t repeat or credit again.
reprocess.applied: Reprocessed: status {status} applied. Recorded in the audit log.
reprocess.noChange: Reprocessed with no change: status {status} was already in place. Recorded in the audit log.
reprocess.duplicate: Duplicate: status {status} had already been applied with this id; nothing repeated. Recorded in the audit log.
reprocess.unknown: The provider didn’t report a status (simulated provider); nothing was applied. Recorded in the audit log.
reprocess.other: Reprocessed: {outcome} (status {status}). Recorded in the audit log.

reconcile.title: Mark {event} as reconciled
reconcile.desc: Use it when the mismatch was already explained outside the panel. It counts once per webhook; the reason stays in the audit log with your name.
reconcile.done: {event} marked as reconciled. Recorded in the audit log.

webhook.recentEmpty: No webhook reprocessed or reconciled through the panel yet.
